title: Verify: Manifest palette and size test covers the item icons and no svg
summary: Extend sceneArtSources.test.ts to assert item icons in manifest
description: Extend game/frontend/tests/sceneArtSources.test.ts, which already imports generateAssets, readPngSize and the committed manifest, with item icon assertions.
acceptance_criteria: Test asserts at least six item/ ids are generated and committed.
Test asserts each item PNG size equals 16x16 and the declared dimensions.
Test asserts no committed manifest path ends in .svg.
technical_constraints: Unit test reading the committed manifest JSON import only; no app or browser.

steps.action: Add a describe block with it('includes at least six item/ icons in generated and committed manifests') filtering generated.entries and committed by id.startsWith('item/'), expecting length >= 6 and that every generated id is in the committed ids.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/sceneArtSources.test.ts -t 'item'

steps.action: For each generated entry with id starting item/, find its file in generated.files by path, assert readPngSize(file.bytes) toEqual {width:16,height:16} and entry.dimensions toEqual the same, and entry.path endsWith '.png'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/sceneArtSources.test.ts -t 'item icon'
steps.expected: All item icons are 16x16 PNGs matching their declared size.

steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/sceneArtSources.test.ts
steps.expected: The whole file passes, including palette and committed-manifest match for the item icons.
